title: Hearty Turkish Lamb Kebabs
description: Peppery, molten lamb kebabs perfect for post-workout fuel, featuring gelatin leafs and a wood-fired finish.
instructions: Rehydrate gelatin leaves in cold water for 5 minutes, then squeeze out excess moisture.
In a large bowl, combine the ground lamb, diced red pepper, minced garlic, cumin, paprika, sumac, salt, pepper, lemon zest, and parsley.
Mix the softened gelatin leaves into the lamb mixture until fully incorporated.
Let the mixture rest in the refrigerator for 30 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Soak wooden skewers in warm water for 10 minutes to prevent burning.
Divide the lamb mixture into 8 equal portions and mold each portion onto a soaked skewer, shaping into a long thin kebab.
Preheat a charcoal or wood-fired grill to medium-high heat and oil the grill grates lightly.
Place the kebabs on the grill and cook for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the lamb reaches an internal temperature of 160°F and the exterior is charred and molten.
Remove the kebabs from the grill and let them rest for 3 minutes before serving.
Serve hot with a side of fresh cucumber salad or grilled tomato slices.
